name: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull
steps: Stand in a wide sumo stance with your toes turned out and a kettlebell centered on the floor between your feet.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees with a flat back to grip the handle with both hands.
Push through both feet and extend your knees and hips to accelerate the bell.
As you stand tall, guide the bell toward your chest with your elbows moving out and up.
Lower the kettlebell smoothly back down and hinge your hips back to return it between your feet.
tips: Finish extending your hips before your arms pull upward so your lower body generates the power.
Keep your elbows higher than your wrists at the top without shrugging excessively into your neck.
